obverse.description:
Red on multicolor underprint.
Portrait of Don Carlos Antonio Lopez (1792–1862), who served as the First President of Paraguay (1844–1862) at right; Paraguayan Coat of Arms and Coat of arms of the Treasury, lion with Phrygian cap and the inscription "Paz y Justicia" (Peace and Justice) above value denomination.
obverse.lettering:
5 BANCO CENTRAL
MIL DEL PARAGUAY
EL BANCO CENTRAL DEL PARAGUAY
RECONOCE ESTE BILLETE POR
5000
CINCO MIL GUARANIES
REPUBLICA DEL PARAGUAY AÑO 2011 PAZ Y JUSTICIA

GERENTE GENERAL PRESIDENTE DON CARLOS ANTONIO LOPEZ
ESTE BILLETE TIENE CURSO LEGAL Y FUERZA CANCELATORIA ILIMITADA EN TODO EL TERRITORIO DE LA REPUBLICA - LEY 489 DEL 29 DE JUNIO DE 1995
BCP
5MIL
obverse.lettering_translation:
5 Thousands
Central Bank of Paraguay
The Central Bank of Paraguay accepts this banknote for 
Five Thousand Guaranies
Year 2022
This banknote is legal tender, and unlimited valid on ll the Republic territory (Law # 489 from June 29th., 1995).

reverse.description: Palacio de Los López in Asunción that serves as workplace for the President of Paraguay and is also the seat of the government of Paraguay.
reverse.lettering:
REPUBLICA DEL PARAGUAY
5000 CINCO MIL GUARANIES
PALACIO DE LOS LÓPEZ
PO SU GUARANI
reverse.lettering_translation:
